description: Editing and reviewing a summary draft.

preconditions: A Ready draft exists; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting with a Ready draft; actorId: its current secretary.
cases.return: Success with the fresh state (MSG391 "Đã duyệt dự thảo."); the draft is marked reviewed with reviewer and time, and other readers may see it from now on.
cases.log: Saved: reviewer and review time on the draft.

preconditions: No draft exists yet; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting without a draft; actorId: its current secretary.

preconditions: A draft is Queued on the worker; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting with a Queued draft; actorId: its current secretary.
cases.return: Failure Busy (MSG387); the mark would end up on a text nobody has read.

preconditions: A Ready draft exists; actor takes part but is neither chair nor secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting with a Ready draft; actorId: an ordinary member.
